name: superuser-management-walkthrough-guide
purpose: Outcome-first walkthrough for the unified Superuser Management Creation.

entries.doFirst: Scan the Creation skill QR or open creation-skill/manifest.json.
entries.expectedResponse: Creation opens with Superuser Management, gateway mesh, prompt guide, queue paths, and audit links loaded.
entries.nextAction: Verify broker/gateway-topology.json and broker/sync-manifest.json are reachable.
entries.stopCondition: Stop if the manifest, gateway topology, or sync manifest cannot load.

entries.outcome: Pair broker ownership and hosted metadata.
entries.doFirst: Use Reconnect from QR or let the Rabbit connector read broker/lease-pairing.json.
entries.expectedResponse: Lease metadata shows 72-hour ownership, Rabbit connector retrieval, and SU unaffected by lease actions.
entries.nextAction: Refresh or renew only if shared result-writing ownership needs to move.
entries.stopCondition: Stop if lease-pairing.json is missing, stale, or not connector-readable.

entries.doFirst: Pick a workflow in the prompt guide.
entries.expectedResponse: The Creation maps the desired outcome to a request template and shows required variables.
entries.nextAction: Fill request_id, device_state, broker_id, lease_holder, and approval_decision.
entries.stopCondition: Stop if required variables are missing or the broker route is not eligible.

entries.outcome: Provoke a broker response without changing the device.
entries.doFirst: Run the request as dry run.
entries.expectedResponse: Broker returns queued, blocked, yielded, or missing-live-check and writes/points to an audit record.
entries.nextAction: Continue only when route, live checks, and approval state are correct.
entries.stopCondition: Stop if any component claims execution without an audit record.

entries.outcome: Use a validated current-boot temporary SU session.
entries.doFirst: Approve live only after the required device restart and live checks.
entries.expectedResponse: Rabbit-native broker may handle allowlisted current-boot actions until the next restart.
entries.nextAction: Execute only the selected allowlisted workflow and record the audit ID.
entries.stopCondition: Stop if the device restarted, broker is not validated, or the action would persist by default.

entries.outcome: Explain what happened or prepare rollback.
entries.doFirst: Search active and archived audit logs.
entries.expectedResponse: Logs identify request, broker, decision, artifact hashes, result, changed items, and rollback clues.
entries.nextAction: Search by request ID, artifact hash, broker ID, action, device state, or time.
entries.stopCondition: Stop if no matching audit evidence exists and label the result as unknown.
